in_marathi.name: Punarvika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Punarvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Punarvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'punar' meaning 'again' and 'vika' meaning 'wave' or 'movement'. It represents the idea of revival, renewal, and the cycle of life. In Hindu mythology, Punarvika is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, wisdom, and learning.

However, the name has the Sanskrit root पुनर् (punar) which means 'again' and विका (vika) which means 'development' or 'growth'. This can be seen as a modern name inspired by the essence of Vedic philosophy that encourages continuous learning, growth, and renewal.
